description: All six runbook gates (0-5) pass on a correctly configured environment: preflight PASS, services healthy, full migration exit 0 with 42 tables, parity audit PASS with report artifact, REST read+write endpoints return 2xx, xUnit suite exit 0, and the agent emits the fixed SUCCESS summary block.
notes: Every expected string/value below is lifted verbatim from the legacy artifacts (agent_runbook.md criteria, verify-prerequisites.sh, migrate_all.py, verify_raven_to_postgres.py, wait-for-api.sh) - nothing hand-invented. Nondeterministic values (timestamps, record counts, test counts, warning counts) are asserted by rule, not by literal. Capture against a live configured run (Docker + reachable RavenDB + .pfx cert) to set validated_against_legacy=true.

config.env_file: .env copied from .env.example, all 8 required vars set and non-placeholder

given.source_dataset: any dataset containing the two hard-coded demo UUIDs used by the gate-4 POST body, or the gate-4 body re-targeted to IDs present in the actual source

body_assert_rules.timestamp: non-empty ISO-8601 timestamp string (value is generated; do not assert literally)

gate_3_parity.stdout_success_matches: ^\[SUCCESS\] 100% COMPLETE PARITY CONFIRMED ACROSS ALL 42 TABLES AND \d+ RECORDS!$

body_assert_rules.tx_no: non-empty generated reference; do not assert literally
body_assert_rules.studentId: echoes the studentId sent in the POST body
body_assert_rules.feeId: echoes the feeId sent in the POST body

post_fee_transaction.side_effect: row present in fee_transaction_audit (trigger trg_fee_transaction_audit fired)

onboarding_summary.format: markdown block per runbook Summary Contract
onboarding_summary.title: ### Onboarding Status: SUCCESS
onboarding_summary.emitted_only_if: every gate 0-5 passed; any failure instead stops the sequence and reports the failing step (stop_on_error: true)

nondeterministic_fields: parity report filename timestamp and total record count
known_unstated: gate-2 success message quoted in the runbook criterion ('All migrations and post-migration scripts completed successfully') is never printed by migrate_all.py - captured here as the script's actual '[=] MIGRATION SUMMARY:' line instead; see open item in specs/migration/runbook-gates.md
